verdict.rationale: Deel ships an official MCP server exposing platform operations (contracts, payroll, time-off) as tools invokable by Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code, with OAuth handled automatically and tool discovery out of the box, directly enabling natural-language operation of the product via AI agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of real-world NL command reliability and broader coverage confirmation beyond the documented tool list.
